'''2009 Bespin Regionals Adam Howland DS This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Adam Howland]] at [[2009 Bespin Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time / Pray I Don't Alter It Any Further|ECC-D-thisdealisgettingworseallthetime.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' The Chief
* '''Username:''' MasterJediAdam
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS17]]
